execution.description: Focused static-panel pytest, read-only Black and pipeline validation after three parallel read-only reviews

expected: Correct slice-length normalization, explicit comparison controls and deterministic complete-task panels without invented timing evidence
observed: Motor review identified a double-normalization risk and unequal-resource comparison ambiguity; the addendum now distinguishes full-stack-equivalent slice averaging from actual-slice summation and does not imply equal copper loss from equal current density. Cooling/Battery and cost-panel reviews found no concrete blocking defects. The repaired candidate's 12 host tests passed, Black left both files unchanged, and the pipeline diagnostic accepted 7 records and 406 then-present lessons while remaining DEFINING with zero awaiting a decision. Host diagnostics are not canonical acceptance. No reference solve, paid dispatch or CPU-hour measurement occurred.
keep: Use communicating domain reviewers to check shared assumptions, with one author integrating one bounded ticket and PR.
change: Bind full-task solve and launch accounting before treating a panel as funded; preserve null timing slots until measured.
